name: Electricsql
description: Sync shape-based subsets of your Postgres data over HTTP.
composeYaml:
services:
  electric:
    image: 'electricsql/electric:1.4.2'
    environment:
      - 'DATABASE_URL=${DATABASE_URL:?}'
      - 'ELECTRIC_SECRET=${ELECTRIC_PASSWORD}'
      - ELECTRIC_STORAGE_DIR=/app/persistent
      - 'ELECTRIC_USAGE_REPORTING=${ELECTRIC_USAGE_REPORTING:-false}'
    volumes:
      - 'electric_data:/app/persistent'
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - '-f'
        - 'http://127.0.0.1:3000/v1/health'
      interval: 10s
      timeout: 5s
      retries: 5
